_readme: IVP recall probe (COLLECTION.md 3), 2026-09-26. Sources independent of the base: the exit-side EDGAR full-text sweep (sources/edgar/fts-hits.json, 216 third-party registrants), the Wikipedia insource sweep (9 company candidates), Redpoint's previous-by-partners list and archived partner bios (the IVP founders' pre-1999 book, decisions.md D4), the portfolio names IVP's own posts repeat as boilerplate, and a parametric pass by era. Each candidate is added (with its citation, as a ledger recall addition) or rejected with its reason.

FTS SPAC/fund/other noise: American Funds proxies (a fund director's IVP past)
10X Capital, Stillwater, Liberty Media Acquisition SPACs
GSV Capital, MVP / FS MVP Private Markets, FlowStone, Powerlaw (registered funds listing holdings)
Thomas Weisel Partners (S-1 names 'professionals or funds affiliated with' IVP among 20 investors; no fund position shown)
I Incubator, Scepter Holdings, Verecloud, Lend Grow, Soul Community Planet, Fatpipe
Redpoint previous-by-partners names with: Bay Networks (Wellfleet added; SynOptics already a row)

notes: IVP's post boilerplate names (MuleSoft, UiPath, Glossier, MasterClass, Niantic, Whoop, Lyra, Eightfold, Jasper, Domo, Kayak, Juniper, Fleetmatics, comScore, Concur, Figma, Supercell, Zynga, Twitter, One Kings Lane, ArcSight, Buddy Media, HomeAway, Dropbox, GitHub, Harness, HashiCorp, Sumo Logic, CrowdStrike, AppDynamics, Rubrik, Slack, Snap) are all already rows.

Pre-1996 IVP positions outside the firm's 2013-2016 list are structurally hard to recover: EDGAR full text starts in 2001, electronic 13Gs in 1996, and the Internet Archive excludes ivp.com. The gap to the firm's stated ~400 investments is reported, not hidden.
